Systems Integration Engineer — Technical Support & Commissioning (Junior–Mid) 
 Company: ALFRED NET
 Location: Bucharest, Romania | On-site
 Employment: Full-time
 ABOUT ALFRED NET 
 At ALFRED NET, we design, integrate, implement and support advanced technology solutions for corporate, industrial, commercial, transportation and critical infrastructure environments.
 Our expertise covers enterprise electronic security, fire detection and life safety, telecommunications, building management and automation, passenger information, public address, integrated monitoring and associated IT and network infrastructure.
 We work with international technology manufacturers, combining software, hardware, networking and engineering expertise to deliver reliable, secure and maintainable systems. Our projects often involve multiple technologies that must communicate and operate together.
 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 We're looking for a curious, motivated engineer who enjoys understanding how things work and solving complex technical problems.
 This is a hands-on role combining configuration, integration, troubleshooting, testing, commissioning and Level 2 support across a diverse technology portfolio. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, customers and manufacturers and progressively take ownership of more challenging work.
 You don't need to know all our platforms from day one. You do need sound technical fundamentals, a structured approach to problem-solving and the determination to learn.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 1. Systems Configuration & Commissioning 
Install, configure, test and commission enterprise applications and associated technical equipment.
Configure servers, controllers, communication interfaces, readers, sensors, I/O modules and other field devices.
Install and validate software components, services and system configurations.
Support upgrades, migrations, expansions and technical changes.
Participate in FAT, SAT, functional tests, commissioning, handover and acceptance.
Verify system behavior against requirements and operational expectations.
 2. Advanced Technical Support & Troubleshooting 
Investigate incidents involving software, hardware, networks, communications and integrations.
Analyze application logs, Windows services, alarms, events and communication errors.
Diagnose issues affecting IP networks, controllers, databases, servers and connected devices.
Isolate root causes, test hypotheses, validate fixes and document corrective actions.
Coordinate technical escalations with manufacturers and specialist support teams.
Progressively assume responsibility for Level 2 support as your competence grows.
 We value engineers who investigate problems, not just report that something doesn't work. 
 3. Systems Integration & Interoperability 
Configure and validate manufacturer-supported integrations between platforms and devices.
Work with middleware, integration services, software interfaces, protocols and APIs.
Test data exchange, event processing, alarm handling and system status.
Investigate compatibility issues and dependencies in multi-vendor environments.
Participate in laboratory testing and validation of new technologies.
Collaborate with engineering colleagues to develop and verify practical solutions.
 We do not expect you to develop manufacturers' drivers. We expect you to understand how systems interact and help make the complete solution work reliably.
 4. IT Infrastructure & Networking 
Work with Windows Server, application services and client/server architectures.
Configure and troubleshoot virtual machines, databases and supporting infrastructure.
Investigate TCP/IP connectivity, VLANs, switching, routing, firewalls and network services.
Understand system dependencies and communication paths.
Support backup, recovery, maintenance and infrastructure monitoring.
Cooperate with customer IT teams to resolve network and platform issues.
 5. Technical Documentation & Collaboration 
Prepare configuration records, test results, commissioning and technical reports.
Document diagnostics, root causes, corrective actions and lessons learned.
Communicate technical findings clearly to colleagues, customers and manufacturers.
Support field engineers during installations, commissioning and complex troubleshooting.
Contribute to laboratory testing, internal procedures and knowledge sharing.
 TECHNOLOGIES YOU'LL ENCOUNTER 
 Our portfolio spans multiple industries and continues to evolve. Depending on your assignments, you may encounter:
 Enterprise Electronic Security — Access control, CCTV/video management, intrusion, biometrics and PSIM; examples include Software House C•CURE 9000, CEM Systems AC2000, LenelS2 OnGuard, Nedap AEOS, Kantech, exacqVision, victor, VideoEdge, Milestone, Axis and DSC.
 Fire Detection & Life Safety — Detection and alarm systems, monitoring and integration, including Johnson Controls Zettler, FireClass and other life-safety technologies.
 Building Management & Automation — BMS, Johnson Controls Metasys, building automation, operational monitoring and industrial communication interfaces.
 Communications & Information Systems — Passenger information, public address and voice alarm, master clocks, time synchronization, professional communications and intelligent transportation systems. Examples include IT.DOT / INFOPIX, Ambient Systems and MOBATIME.
 IT & Integration — Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Hyper-V, VMware, TCP/IP networking, OSDP, SNMP, Modbus, REST APIs and other supported interfaces.
 These examples illustrate our environment; they are NOT a required knowledge checklist. We value technical fundamentals and learning ability more than prior experience with any specific manufacturer.
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 Technical Foundations 
Background in IT, networking, electronics, telecommunications, automation, computer engineering or a related area.
Good understanding of IP addressing, networks and basic communication principles.
Familiarity with Windows, hardware/software troubleshooting and technical documentation.
Ability to understand architectures, interfaces and dependencies between systems.
Willingness to work with both software and physical equipment.
 Analytical Thinking & Attitude 
Curiosity about how systems operate and why failures occur.
Methodical troubleshooting: separate symptoms from root causes, test assumptions and verify outcomes.
Ability to research unfamiliar technologies and apply what you've learned.
Ownership, initiative, integrity, attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Collaborative mindset, clear communication and willingness to ask questions and share knowledge.
Persistence in following problems through to resolution.
 Communication & Availability 
Good Romanian and English, including technical communication with international manufacturers.
Availability for occasional site visits and travel, depending on project requirements.
 NICE TO HAVE — NOT MANDATORY 
Experience in security systems, automation, BMS, telecommunications or technical integration.
Exposure to enterprise software, field controllers, networking equipment or industrial protocols.
Windows Server, SQL, virtualization, PowerShell, scripting or APIs.
FAT/SAT, commissioning, advanced support or manufacturer certifications.
 Experience with our specific products is an advantage, not a requirement. 
 WHAT YOU'LL FIND AT ALFRED NET 
Real engineering challenges across corporate, industrial, commercial and infrastructure projects.
A diverse, multi-vendor technology environment — not a single-product career path.
Hands-on learning through laboratory testing, experimentation and real projects.
Mentorship, knowledge sharing and direct collaboration with international manufacturers.
A clear opportunity to develop specialized expertise and greater technical responsibility over time.
 WHO SHOULD APPLY? 
 You might be an early-career engineer, an IT or networking professional, or someone from electronics, telecoms or automation who wants broader engineering challenges.
 We care more about how you think, how you learn and how seriously you take responsibility than about the number of products listed on your CV.
 We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone with the curiosity, discipline and determination to figure things out. 
 If this sounds like you, apply through LinkedIn and tell us about a technical problem you've investigated and solved — especially one that required you to learn something new.
 ALFRED NET | Engineering Integration. Delivering Reliability.
